name: Law2_ScGeom_JCFpmPhys_JointedCohesiveFrictionalPM
description: Interaction law for cohesive frictional material, e.g. rock, possibly presenting joint surfaces, that can be mechanically described with a smooth contact logic [Ivars2011]_ (implemented in Yade in [Scholtes2012]_). See examples/jointedCohesiveFrictionalPM for script examples. Joint surface...

attributes.name: smoothJoint
attributes.description: if true, interactions of particles belonging to joint surface (JCFpmPhys.isOnJoint) are handled according to a smooth contact logic (Ivars2011), (Scholtes2012).

attributes.name: neverErase
attributes.description: Keep interactions even if particles go away from each other (only in case another constitutive law is in the scene

attributes.name: cracksFileExist
attributes.description: if true (and if recordCracks), data are appended to an existing 'cracksKey' text file; otherwise its content is reset.

attributes.name: momentsFileExist
attributes.description: if true (and if recordCracks), data are appended to an existing 'momentsKey' text file; otherwise its content is reset.

attributes.name: Key
attributes.description: string specifying the name of saved file 'cracks___.txt', when

attributes.name: recordCracks
attributes.description: if true, data about interactions that lose their cohesive feature are stored in the text file cracksKey.txt (see Key and cracksFileExist). It contains 9 columns: the break iteration, the 3 coordinates of the contact point, the type (1 means shear break, while 0 corresponds to tensile break), the ''cross section'' (mean radius of the 2 spheres) and the 3 coordinates of the contact normal.

attributes.name: recordMoments
attributes.description: Combines with :yref: `Key<Law2ScGeom_JCFpmPhys_JointedCohesiveFrictionalPM.Key>` to compute acoustic emissions according to clustered broken bond method? (off by default)

attributes.name: nbTensCracks
attributes.description: number of tensile microcracks.

attributes.name: nbShearCracks
attributes.description: number of shear microcracks.

attributes.name: totalTensCracksE
attributes.description: calculate the overall energy dissipated by interparticle microcracking in tension.

attributes.name: totalShearCracksE
attributes.description: calculate the overall energy dissipated by interparticle microcracking in shear.

attributes.name: totalCracksSurface
attributes.description: calculate the total cracked surface.

attributes.name: computedCentroid
attributes.description: computer clustered moments?

attributes.name: momentRadiusFactor
attributes.description: Average particle diameter multiplier for moment magnitude calculation

attributes.name: eventNumber
attributes.description: cluster event number (used for clustering and paraview visualization of groups).

attributes.name: momentFudgeFactor
attributes.description: Fudge factor used by Hazzard and Damjanac 2013 to improve moment size accuracy (set to 1 for no impact by default)

attributes.name: clusterMoments
attributes.description: computer clustered moments? (on by default

attributes.name: useStrainEnergy
attributes.description: use strain energy for moment magnitude estimation (if false, use kinetic energy)

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
